_notes: Gate C sites (extends adbench gates.json). Logged out, no purchases, no accounts, never solve image puzzles. wait = s before the first text copy; the page text is copied every 5 s until `ready` (regex, multiline + dotall) or max_wait. steps (form sites) start from the page's own focus right after the URL is opened, with no ready poll and no click: type ({email}, {email_gmail}, {username} = unregistered random placeholders), key (xdotool key names: Tab, Return, space, Escape) with optional repeat, wait s; then the text is polled until `after`. Verdict: `block` regex wins, else `pass` regex, else ready = pass. metrics: regex with one capture group. rule: per metric, ours vs stock on the same IP: min = ours >= stock - n, max = ours <= stock + n, same = equal to stock (or equal to `good`). copy_at = [x, y] fractions of a blank point clicked before select-all. switch_hint: the internal switch to turn off first when ours fails (see switches.json); every site reads the WebGL renderer, so today that is gpu-family.
